name: raion-monorepo
description: Raion: observability as a platform on top of OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Grafana and Alertmanager.

scripts.build: tsc -b && pnpm --filter @raion/web build && pnpm --filter @raion/schema run export-json-schema
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/core/test && tsc -p packages/deploy/test && tsc -p apps/server/test && tsc -p apps/cli/test && pnpm --filter @raion/web typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run validate:examples
scripts.test:e2e: node e2e/rules.e2e.mjs && node e2e/runtime.e2e.mjs && node e2e/nodejs.e2e.mjs && node e2e/polyglot.e2e.mjs
